run_check_templates_match: run the script to verify template episode instructions match LLM-scale episode instructions
compare_template_and_llm_instructions: compare template episode instructions with LLM-generated instructions for up to 10 episodes
extract_template_task_number: extract the template task number from a dataset episode using the utility function
load_template_episodes: load template episodes from a gzipped JSON dataset file and map them by index
verify_episode_links: verify that the link to template episodes is correct by displaying side-by-side instructions
